changelog:
Initial release of the Amazon Best Sellers listing scraper skill.

- Extracts ranked product lists, ASINs, titles, URLs, images, prices, ratings, and review counts from any Amazon Best Sellers (/zgbs/ or /gp/bestsellers/) page, supporting all Amazon regional domains.
- Provides additional category metadata (name, full name, URL) and pagination details (current page, has next page, next page URL).
- Supports pagination for accessing beyond the first 50 items when available.
- Designed for competitive intelligence, discovering top/trending products, niche research, sourcing ASINs, and rank tracking.
- Reads only what the user can see—no logins, no bypassing of Amazon security or access controls.
summary: Amazon Best Sellers listing scraper: extract product cards from any Amazon Best Sellers (zgbs) or /gp/bestsellers/ category page — returns rank (position on chart), asin, title, url, image, imageAlt, price, stars, reviewCount, ratingRaw per item, plus category metadata (categoryName, categoryFullNam
